Provider.note: A model vendor such as OpenAI or Anthropic, not a generic supplier or a service provider in the telecom sense.

Assistant.note: A user-configured chat persona (system prompt + model settings). Distinct from Agent.

Agent.note: An autonomous coding agent with tool access and its own session, not a synonym for Assistant.

Knowledge Base.note: A user-built document collection queried via retrieval.

Topic.note: One conversation thread inside an assistant, comparable to a chat in other clients.
